blurb: Houseboat Holidays offers houseboat rentals on the St. Lawrence River in the 1000 Islands area. They have been operating since 1972 and focus on providing exceptional customer service and worry-free vacations. Guests can explore the river's bays, routes, and secrets with their family-run business.
extraNote: Deposit required when booking · If cancelled boat is re-rented, deposit is returned; otherwise not · Cancellations due to emergencies are understood · Just over 20 weeks during the summer season
